west-con.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 5 West-Con locations, 3 in South Dakota and 2 in Minnesota. On the South Dakota side that means Aberdeen, Milbank and Twin Brooks, and over in Minnesota it is Appleton and Holloway. The table carries corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot.

wheatfield-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 7 Wheatfield Grain locations across 3 states. Indiana carries 5 of them, with towns like Demotte, Morocco, Rensselaer and Wheatfield, plus 1 in Crescent City, Illinois and 1 in Paw Paw, Michigan. The table carries corn, soybeans and wheat.
